body:
A tool to generate normal maps from any sprite and animated sprite sheet.

Enlaces: código: https://github.com/Hugo-Dz/spritefusion-sprite-normals Estrellas en GitHub: 725

- Online version: https://www.spritefusion.com/sprite-normals - API: https://www.spritefusion.com/docs/pixel-art-generator/api/generate-and-transform-imagesnormal-maps - MCP: https://www.spritefusion.com/docs/pixel-art-generator/api/mcp

A tool to generate normal maps for pixel art sprites and animations. Written in Rust, available as a CLI and a WebAssembly library.
